title: Baked falafel salad bowl
summary: Baked falafel salad bowl is a mediterranean dinner built around canned chickpeas in water and gram flour, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Baked falafel salad bowl into even pieces and toss gram flour with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of gram flour while you season canned chickpeas in water. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle canned chickpeas in water and onions among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Baked falafel salad bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Baked falafel salad bowl into warm bowls with the juices.
